title: Probavi adapter protocol v0 — provision response payload
description: Connection info, source identity, measured timings, and opaque state returned by a successful provision (adapter-protocol.md §6.2).
$comment: Derived from docs/adapter-protocol.md, which is normative. On any disagreement the markdown document wins.

checksum.description: sha256 over the source bytes; multi-file sources document their canonical hashing rule in the adapter README.

created_at.description: The backup's own creation time if derivable, else null. Any RFC 3339 instant; the core normalizes it to the evidence schema's millisecond UTC form by truncation (adapter protocol §6.2).

timings.description: Real measurements from a monotonic clock, never estimates (§7).

state.description: Opaque to the core: stored as-is, passed verbatim to healthcheck and teardown. No secrets.

connection.title: connection object (§6.2)
connection.description: Reachability from inside the sandbox. password_env names an environment variable — never a value.
